notes: The San Francisco Call's daily Building Contracts list for the whole of 1909: every issue in curiv_jenner_ver01, curiv_llano_ver01, curiv_mecca_ver01 and curiv_needles_ver01 (365 issues, 7,870 OCR pages). Located as in 1910, by the list's heading and the entry's shape ('with CONTRACTOR - WORK ... line/corner of ...; $AMOUNT'), the 'with' widened again for 1909's OCR ('wirh', 'witu', 'wifit', 'wuh'); a block was kept where it carried two 'line of'/'corner of' phrases, or a heading and the entry shape, and 16 entries whose 'with' the OCR lost were kept by a dash followed by a work word. Read in one pass, by one reader, from the 1910 spec; private owners, estates, trustees and surname partnerships are cut from raw and extra, institutional and company owners kept in extra.owner_firm, and one notable owner a published source already covers (Ina Coolbrith, at 1067 Broadway, whose residency the NRHP nomination on the page records) kept in extra.owner_notable. A contractor's name garbled past repair is kept as printed and printed as 'a builder' on the page. 1909's OCR reads a capital N as X: 'X line' is the N line and 'X street' is N street (Noriega), not Moraga; the lettered streets (A to W) were renamed in 1909 and read as their present names (A Anza, D Fulton, H Lincoln Way, I Irving ... W Wawona); First avenue is Arguello, Dupont Grant, Point Lobos Geary, Montgomery avenue Columbus, Army Cesar Chavez. Placed with corner.py --batch --json: a single parcel matching the record's lot within 4% or its offset within 4 ft, the roll year within two years of 1909 - an alteration a building standing by 1908, through corner.py's new built_by field - the side or quadrant the record names, a storey count not off by 1.5 or more, a corner with neither lot nor offset only on the corner lot, and where the lot has an illegible dimension, a frontage not narrower than the printed one by more than 5 ft. Named buildings placed by hand by name: the Palace Hotel, Old St. Mary's, the Elkan-Gunst, Phelan, Union Trust (Market and Grant), Monadnock, Westbank, Metropolitan Life, Goldberg Bowen, City of Paris, Kohler & Chase and Anglo and London Paris National Bank buildings, the Columbia Theater, the Cliff House, the Bohemian, Olympic and Elks' clubs, the Odd Fellows' hall, St. John's Episcopal and First Baptist churches, Mary's Help, French, St. Francis and Children's hospitals, and Presidio Terrace lots 18, 20 and 31 (the tract's lot numbers are today's numbers). Only 17 entries print a street number; the rest print a line and an offset or a corner, which the 1909 renumbering cannot move. One entry per building: the general contract, else the earliest, carries the page's entry.

coverage.remaining: Nothing of the 1909 daily lists is known to remain unread: all 365 issues the four batches hold were scanned, 346 page-blocks on 233 days located and read whole. The 132 days without a block are Sundays and holidays the list did not run, and days whose OCR lost the heading and the entry shape both; those were not hand-searched. Of the 960 unresolved, 374 have no parcel matching the lot or offset with a roll year near 1909 (the building replaced, or the lot re-cut), 294 single candidates were refused (side, roll year, storeys, not the corner lot), 16 match several parcels, 67 are on streets EAS no longer joins (Gardiner, Ankeny, Webb, Marshall, Silver at Third, the Bayview 'avenues South'), 191 could not be measured (no cross street, no quadrant, an illegible offset or direction, a named building no parcel carries), 15 print a number with no EAS record or no cross street to check it against, and 3 sit on parcels since retired.
coverage.note: 7,870 OCR pages scanned (every page of 1909 in curiv_jenner, curiv_llano, curiv_mecca and curiv_needles); 346 page-blocks located; 1,385 candidate segments read, 421 of them not entries (deeds, ads, repeated headings), 1,253 contract entries read, 9 of them reprints collapsed - 1,244 findings (1,119 building contracts, 121 alterations, 4 architect credits from the real estate news beside the list). 284 resolved by hand - 230 by corner, offset and lot with corner.py's geometry, 53 on a building the record names, 1 on a printed number checked against its cross streets - and 960 unresolved, each with its reason. 229 published on 228 pages; 55 declined, further contracts for a building whose entry already carries one.
